query: How should CAB composition, selection process, compensation, and formal decision-making authority be defined to safeguard contested narratives and allow post-dissemination revocation and remediation?

response.query: How should CAB composition, selection process, compensation, and formal decision-making authority be defined to safeguard contested narratives and allow post-dissemination revocation and remediation?
response.answer: CAB composition should include diverse experts, selection should be transparent, compensation should be fair, and decision-making authority must allow for revocation and remediation post-dissemination.

results.title: Outdoors
results.content: With the change in the hunting regulations approved by the Alabama Conservation Advisory Board, the Alabama Department of Conservation and Natural Resources’ (ADCNR) Wildlife and Freshwater Fisheries (WFF) Division expanded the opportunities to manage deer herds with an increase in the daily bag limit for does from one per day to two per day in most of the state (www.outdooralabama.com/seasons-and-bag-limits/deer-season). “We appreciate the Conservation Advisory Board and Department of Conservation and Natural Resources increasing the harvest limit for does and fully support the Hunters Helping the Hungry program,” said Alabama Farmers Federation President Jimmy Parnell. By working with Outdoor Alabama and our partners across the state, we are now able to provide a bit easier access through the hotline.” said Victoria Miller, Fish Guide Coordinator with Coosa Riverkeeper and project organizer. “I love Alabama to begin with, and it’s been several years since I’ve been here,” Powell said.
